none: Black baseball cap with multicolor embroidery. Front of cap: "I [heart] President Obama" in black; "heart" symbol has "44th" in black lettering superimposed on United States flag in red, white, and blue fill. Red, white, and blue stars embroidered on brim in six parallel rows. Right side of cap has small heart-shaped decal of portrait of Barack Obama superimposed on United States flag in red, white, and blue fill. Adjustable strap on back of cap has "I [heart] Obama" in black embroidery; "heart" is in the pattern of the United States flag in red, white, and blue fill. Square silver decal of City Hunter on center right of brim.

This collection documents the extraordinary cultural outpouring of celebratory materials from across the continent of Africa.  They represent Africa’s pride in, ownership of and hopefulness for the candidacy and presidency of Barack Obama.
